# Triton sandbox MCP server

A stdio MCP server that gives a model Triton sandboxes. Built on
`@triton/sandbox` and the official MCP TypeScript SDK.

Tools: `create_sandbox`, `run_command`, `read_file`, `write_file`,
`list_files`, `get_preview_url`, `run_code`, `screenshot`, `click`,
`type_text`, `kill_sandbox`. `create_sandbox` takes a sandbox `package`
(for example `sandbox-4g`); without one it uses the deployment's default.
Where previews are off, `get_preview_url` answers "previews are not
enabled on this cloud; use port-forward".

```
cd sdks/typescript && npm install && npm run build
cd ../mcp && npm install && npm run build
```

Client config (Claude Desktop, Claude Code and others):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "triton-sandbox": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/path/to/sdks/mcp/dist/index.js"],
      "env": { "TRITON_URL": "https://...", "TRITON_API_KEY": "..." }
    }
  }
}
```

A model can be steered by text it reads, so by default the tools reach
only the sandboxes this server created. Set `TRITON_MCP_ALLOW_ANY=1` to let
them reach any sandbox the credential can see. Tool output is cut at
100 KiB per field.

`npm test` runs the tools against the shared mock API.
